Hi Alex —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps based on our call:

Recap:
- Primary goal: reduce average time-to-insight for clinical review workflows by surfacing summarized notes and smart search across patient records.
- Success metrics you mentioned: 30% reduction in manual triage time and <200ms median token latency for the critical path.
- Constraints: PHI handling (HIPAA), regional hosting in US, and a pilot dataset of ~100k records.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep-dive / demo (60–75 min) — show model outputs on a sanitized subset, discuss integration patterns and SLA/throughput expectations.
2) Eval kick-off (30–45 min) — review trial plan, success criteria, prompt set, and data access checklist.

Times I can offer next week (pick one):
- Mon 16 Aug — 10:00–11:30 PT
- Tue 17 Aug — 14:00–15:30 PT
- Wed 18 Aug — 09:00–10:30 PT

If those don't work, share a few slots and I’ll loop in Rishi (solutions) and Marissa (onboarding).

Attached: draft trial plan, sample prompt set, and our evaluation checklist so you can skim before the call.

Thanks,
Ben
